title: Part sale rows show a dash in the labor columns and the totals do not change
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • {Location-A}'s Shop Supplies Charge is 0%, and nothing else is invoiced at {Location-A} today.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-1} (one part at $80.00) and work order {Work-order-1} (one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour) for {Customer-A} both have Sales Representative {Sales-rep-A}, and both were invoiced today.
    For example: {Part-sale-1} is P-30001 and {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: on {Part-sale-1}'s row Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin show a dash where the report used to show 0.00 and $0.00. {Sales-rep-A}'s summary row reads Labor Invoiced $200.00 and Parts Invoiced $80.00, the same totals as before the release.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • Release day: “One display change on Sales By Representative: a Part Sales row shows a dash in Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin (an empty cell in the CSV), where today's report shows 0.00 and $0.00. A part sale has no labor, so these columns don't apply to it (S5-R15b). Totals don't change.”
  • S5-R15b: “On a Part Sales row, Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin, and the labor and hours cells of the Expanded downloads, show a dash on screen and in the PDF and are blank in the CSV. A part sale has no labor, so these columns don't apply to it.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 39: “39. (a) A dash on screen and in the PDF, and an empty cell in the CSV, as the design shows. A part sale has no labor, so the labor columns don't apply to it; it's the same rule as answers 24 and 25. This changes today's 0.00 / $0.00, so it's now listed under Release day. New S5-R15b, PRD v11.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
